uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Saved Encounters on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the encounter windows on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

placeHidden.name: Place hidden
placeHidden.hint: Placed monsters start hidden from the players, so you can reveal them when the moment comes.

combatAddPlayers.name: The heroes join the fight
combatAddPlayers.hint: Place and fight also adds the visible tokens of the player characters on the scene to the combat.

pinShowsName.name: Name on the map pin
pinShowsName.hint: A map pin shows the name of its encounter below the icon. Players never see encounter pins.

Tool.save: Save selected tokens as an encounter

Keys.saveSelected: Save the selected tokens as an encounter
Keys.turnLeft: Turn the group left while placing
Keys.turnRight: Turn the group right while placing
Keys.turnHint: While the monsters follow the mouse, turns the whole group by 90° around its middle. Ctrl or Shift and the mouse wheel turn it too.

Window.title: Saved Encounters
Window.menuHint: All saved encounters of this world, ready to place on the map.
Window.saveHint: Select monsters on the map, then save them as an encounter with their positions.
Window.empty: No encounters yet. Select the monsters on the map and click Save selected tokens.
Window.pin: Put a pin on the map
Window.atPin: Place at the pin on this scene
Window.again: Place again: remove the placed monsters and set them up fresh
Window.turnLeft: Turn the group 90° left, for the next placement and the pin
Window.turnRight: Turn the group 90° right, for the next placement and the pin
Window.deleteText: Delete the encounter "{name}" and its map pins? Monsters already on a scene stay there.

Editor.name: Name
Editor.folderName: Give the new folder a name.
Editor.formulaHint: Empty places them as saved. A number or a dice formula like 1d4+1 is rolled each time you place the encounter.
Editor.unique: A unique character, placed once and left out when it already stands on the scene
Editor.drop: Drop actors here from the sidebar or a compendium to add them.
Editor.lootDrop: Drop a roll table here for the loot of this encounter.
Editor.ledgerHint: Without Loot Ledger the table is drawn into the chat. With it, your players claim the loot with need, want or pass.
Editor.notesHint: Tactics, treasure, what happens when the fight turns
Editor.keepChanges: Keep the changes on these tokens
Editor.keepChangesHint: Some tokens were changed during play, for example lost hit points. Without the tick every placement starts fresh.
Editor.noTokens: An encounter needs at least one monster.
Editor.badFormula: "{formula}" for {name} is no number or dice formula.

Preview.placeFight: Click to place {name} and start the fight ({count} tokens)
Preview.pin: Click to pin {name} to the map
Preview.keys: Shift: no grid snap · right click or Esc: cancel

Turn.keys: {keys} or Ctrl and mouse wheel: turn the group
Turn.wheel: Ctrl and mouse wheel: turn the group

Notice.selectTokens: Select the tokens of the encounter on the map first.
Notice.missingActors: These actors were not found and stay out: {names}
Notice.linkedSkipped: These unique characters already stand on this scene and were not placed again: {names}
Notice.linkedSkippedFight: These unique characters already stand on this scene. They were not placed again and stay out of the fight: {names}
Notice.noneRolled: The counts of "{name}" came out as zero, nothing to place.
Notice.imported: {count} actors were imported from compendiums into the folder Encounter monsters.
Notice.pinCompendium: Import the encounter from the compendium first, then pin it to the map.
Notice.pinned: Pin for "{name}" set. Double click it to open the encounter, Alt and double click places it.
Notice.pinnedHidden: Pin for "{name}" set. It shows when the journal notes are visible on the map.
Notice.noPin: "{name}" has no pin on this scene.
Notice.noLoot: This encounter has no loot table.
Notice.lootMissing: The loot table of this encounter was not found.
Notice.initiativeFailed: The monsters are in the fight, but their initiative could not be rolled: {error}

SELFTEST.Title: Saved Encounters self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks grid snapping, token creation, fights, compendium import, the storage and a test placement. The result appears as a whisper in the chat.
SELFTEST.Snap: Foundry's grid snapping for tokens was not found.
SELFTEST.Coordinates: Foundry's conversion between screen and map was not found.
SELFTEST.Combat: Foundry's initiative roll was not found.
SELFTEST.Import: Foundry's import from compendiums was not found.
SELFTEST.Drop: Foundry's drag and drop data was not found.
SELFTEST.Broken: These encounters could not be read: {names}
SELFTEST.Plan: The test encounter could not be planned.
SELFTEST.Positions: The test encounter could not be placed on the grid of this scene.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Saved Encounters was verified with an older Foundry version ({versions}). Run the self test in the module settings to check it.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
